channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: NASA's Webb finds signs of Mars-sized worlds smashing together
item.description: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope is giving astronomers a glimpse of the kinds of violent collisions that may have shaped our own solar system.

item.title: Drug target could block brain inflammation linked to Alzheimer's and Parkinson's
item.description: Blocking a receptor called P2X7 significantly reduced inflammation in human brain tissue, revealing a potential new treatment strategy for neurological conditions.

item.title: Physicists find evidence of 'ghost' superconductivity
item.description: Physicists report striking evidence of an unusual superconducting behavior in uranium ditelluride, where electron pairs organize into ripples.

item.title: Zoo lions' feeding change brings out wild behavior
item.description: Giving zoo lions whole carcasses on a feast-and-fast schedule appears to bring out more natural behavior, with lions spending nearly three times longer feeding.
